_comment: These are REAL collisions, not false positives -- they are listed so the gate
can block NEW ones without forcing an unrelated UX decision in the same change.
Fix them and delete the entry; never add to this file to silence a new clash.

duplicates.note: notification-bell.tsx hardcodes the LEGACY leader 'mod+g n' while quick-task registers key 'n' (so both 'mod+k n' and 'mod+g n'). Only the legacy leader clashes; 'mod+k n' is unambiguously quick-task. Resolution is a UX call: move notifications to its own free key, or drop its legacy binding.

prefixes.note: go-home on 'Escape' vs interrupt on 'Escape Escape'. May be deliberate if the key layer resolves double-tap by timeout; flagged so the question gets answered rather than assumed.
